name: Job Map Express
tagline: Sketches the full Jobs-to-be-Done map for a product idea, right in chat
description: A cartographer for Jobs-to-be-Done thinking, aimed at product people. In a single chat it sketches the whole job map: the core job to be done, the metrics that matter, the related jobs around it, and the consumption chain it sits inside. The point is seeing where a solution genuinely fits before anyone builds.
author: mikeboysen
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
